about: Frontdesk evaluation set. Everything here is fictional. Each case is one visitor question against a scenario (business details, rules and knowledge). Checks are case-insensitive. includeAny: at least one of each group must appear. exclude: none may appear. unanswered: whether the model must (true) or must not (false) call report_unanswered.

law.rules: Never give legal advice; offer a consultation instead.

knowledge.title: Fees
knowledge.content: A fixed-fee simple will costs £250 plus VAT. A first 30-minute consultation costs £60 plus VAT. Conveyancing fees start at £850 plus VAT.

knowledge.title: Areas of law
knowledge.content: We help with wills and probate, residential conveyancing, landlord and tenant disputes, and employment law for individuals. We do not handle criminal cases.
